items.title: BREAD from JUST 4 SEEDS in 5 Minutes! No Flour, No Sugar, No Yeast!
items.description: Learn how to make an easy bread from JUST 4 SEEDS with no flour, sugar, or yeast! This gluten-free oat and seed bread is hearty, flavorful, and requires no kneading. @breador Stay until the end for a second quick bread made with Greek yogurt and almond flour, plus a delicious protein-packed skillet sandwich. These easy bread recipes are perfect for breakfast, toast, sandwiches, or meal prep. 4-SEED OAT BREAD Ingredients: - 3 tbsp pumpkin seeds - 3 tbsp sunflower seeds - 2 tbsp sesame seeds - 3 tbsp whole flaxseeds - 3-4 tbsp flaxseeds, ground - 80 g rolled oats, ground - 2 tbsp rolled oats, left whole - About 1 tsp ground coriander - About 1 tsp Italian seasoning - 1 tbsp baking powder - 3 eggs - 1/4 tsp salt - 1/4 tsp black pepper - 100 ml water - 30 ml olive oil - Extra pumpkin and sesame seeds for topping Instructions: 1. Lightly toast the pumpkin, sunflower, and sesame seeds in a dry pan. Keep stirring and remove them once they smell nutty. 2. Leave half of the toasted seeds whole and grind the other half into a crumbly meal. Stop before they turn into a paste. 3. Combine both portions with the whole and ground flaxseeds, ground oats, whole rolled oats, coriander, Italian seasoning, and baking powder. 4. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper. Mix in the water and olive oil, then pour the wet ingredients into the dry mixture. 5. Stir well, cover, and let the mixture rest for 15 minutes so the oats and flaxseeds can absorb the liquid. 6. Transfer the mixture to a lined and lightly greased loaf pan. Smooth the top, brush it with a little water, score the center, and sprinkle with pumpkin and sesame seeds. 7. Bake at 180°C or 350°F for 35-40 minutes. Let the bread cool completely before slicing so the center can finish setting. GREEK YOGURT AND ALMOND FLOUR BREAD Ingredients: - 2 eggs - 300 g Greek yogurt - 1/4 tsp salt, or to taste - About 200 g almond flour - 1/2 tbsp baking powder - Optional oregano, rosemary, or garlic powder - Olive oil for greasing - Sesame seeds or chopped nuts for topping Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C or 350°F. 2. Whisk the eggs just until combined. Add the Greek yogurt and mix until smooth and creamy. 3. Mix in the salt and any optional seasonings. Gradually add the almond flour until the batter reaches the consistency shown in the video, then mix in the baking powder. 4. Pour the batter into a lined and lightly greased loaf pan. Smooth the top and sprinkle it with sesame seeds or your favorite nuts. 5. Bake until the top is golden and the loaf is completely cooked through. Do not open the oven door during the first 20 minutes. 6. Let the loaf cool completely at room temperature before slicing. PROTEIN-PACKED SKILLET SANDWICH You will need: - A few slices of the almond flour bread - 2 eggs - 1/4 tsp salt - Black pepper to taste - 1 small bunch of finely chopped parsley - Grated Parmesan, optional - Lettuce and tomato, or your preferred fillings Mix the eggs, salt, black pepper, parsley, and optional Parmesan. Lightly grease a pan and arrange the bread slices inside. Pour the egg mixture over the slices and into the spaces between them. Once the bottom has set, carefully flip everything over. When the second side is cooked, add lettuce, tomato, avocado, cheese, sautéed mushrooms, or your favorite protein, then fold and serve. IMPORTANT NOTES - For a strictly gluten-free recipe, use certified gluten-free oats and baking powder. - The exact amount of almond flour may vary depending on the size of the eggs, the consistency of the yogurt, and the moisture of the almond flour. - Always let both loaves cool completely before slicing. Which bread would you try first? Let me know in the comments, and tell me which country you’re watching from! If you enjoyed these quick and healthy bread recipes, please like the video, subscribe to the channel, and share it with someone who loves homemade bread. items.title: I Stopped Buying Bread After I Made This Walnut Loaf
items.description: I stopped buying bread after I made this walnut loaf. No flour. No oil in the batter. No yeast. No added sugar. No kneading. Naturally gluten-free. @Breador This flourless walnut bread is soft, moist, nutty, and surprisingly filling. It’s a simple, healthy bread made with walnuts, sunflower seeds, sesame seeds, eggs, and Greek yogurt. Toasting the nuts and seeds first gives every slice a rich, roasted flavor and a lovely crunch. This high-protein, low-carb bread slices beautifully and tastes even better toasted. Enjoy it for breakfast with cheese or avocado, serve it with soup, or simply have a slice with tea. INGREDIENTS 200 g walnuts 100 g sunflower seeds, plus extra for topping 2 tbsp sesame seeds, plus extra for topping 2 eggs 1/4 tsp salt 2 tbsp Greek yogurt 1 tsp baking powder A little oil for greasing HOW TO MAKE IT 1. Grind the walnuts in short bursts until fine and crumbly. Be careful not to turn them into walnut butter. Transfer them to a dry pan. 2. Grind the sunflower seeds until they look like coarse flour, then add them to the pan. 3. Toast everything over low heat for up to 15 minutes, stirring constantly. Once the mixture is lightly golden and smells deeply roasted, it’s ready. 4. Remove the pan from the heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons of sesame seeds, give everything one final mix, and let it cool completely. 5. Crack 2 eggs into a bowl. Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and whisk until smooth and well combined. 6. Add 2 tablespoons of Greek yogurt and whisk until combined. 7. Fold in the completely cooled nut and seed mixture until there are no dry patches left. 8. Add 1 teaspoon of baking powder and mix well so it’s evenly distributed. 9. Line a loaf pan with parchment paper and brush it lightly with oil. Add the batter, smooth the top, and score a line down the center with a knife. 10. Top with extra sesame seeds and sunflower seeds. 11. Bake in a preheated oven at 170°C / 350°F for 30 minutes. 12. Let the bread rest in the pan for 10 to 15 minutes. Lift it out using the parchment paper, carefully remove the paper, and let the loaf cool completely on a wire rack before slicing. TIPS Pulse the walnuts in short bursts so they don’t turn into walnut butter. Keep the heat low while toasting and stir constantly. Ground nuts can burn quickly. Let the toasted mixture cool completely before adding it to the eggs. Don’t slice the loaf while it’s still warm. It may crumble, and the center can stay gummy if it hasn’t cooled completely. For a celiac-friendly loaf, make sure your baking powder and other packaged ingredients are certified gluten-free. Storage: Keep the bread in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. You can also slice and freeze it for later. items.title: I Stopped Buying Yogurt After I Tried This With Oats
items.description: Creamy strawberry oat yogurt made with rolled oats, fresh strawberries, flaxseed, chia seeds, and plain yogurt. No fermenting, gelatin, or food coloring. @breador This easy make-ahead breakfast thickens overnight in the refrigerator. Its smooth, silky texture comes from oat starch, homemade flaxseed gel, and chia seeds. Plain yogurt adds a gentle tang, with no yogurt maker or countertop fermentation needed. For a fully plant-based version, use unsweetened coconut or soy yogurt, replace the honey with maple syrup, and use plant-based milk if you need to thin it. INGREDIENTS 1 cup rolled oats (100 g) 2 cups warm water (480 ml), for soaking the oats 2 tablespoons whole flaxseeds 1 cup water (240 ml), for the flaxseed gel 1 teaspoon lemon juice 1/4 cup plain yogurt (60 ml) 12 medium strawberries (about 150 g) 1 tablespoon honey or maple syrup 1 tablespoon chia seeds A splash of milk, if needed The leftover oat pulp can be saved for pancakes, muffins, or porridge. STORAGE: Keep it in an airtight container in the refrigerator and enjoy it within three days for the best taste and texture. If you try this recipe, tell me how it turned out. items.title: I Tested 3 Viral Flourless Breads — Chickpea vs Red Lentil vs Whole Lentil
items.description: Chickpea bread, red lentil bread, and whole lentil bread — all made with no flour, no yeast, and no kneading. Four loaves, two recipes. @breador I baked three mini loaves side by side to find out which flourless loaf actually comes out best, then made a full-size egg-free red lentil loaf for anyone baking vegan. No flour blends, no specialty ingredients — just soaked legumes blended into a batter. ✅ No flour, no yeast, no kneading ✅ Naturally gluten-free ✅ High in plant protein and fiber ✅ Soft enough to slice, sturdy enough to toast RECIPE 1 — Three mini loaves (makes 3 small round loaves: - 1 cup dry legumes — chickpeas (soaked overnight, then simmered until soft), split red lentils (soaked 2–3 hrs), or whole brown/green lentils (soaked 6–8 hrs) - 2 eggs - 1 tbsp olive oil - ½ tbsp baking powder -salt and pepper to taste One extra per bowl: 1 tbsp cumin (chickpea) / 1 tbsp flaxseeds (red lentil) / 1 tbsp psyllium husk (whole lentil) Top with sunflower and pumpkin seeds. Bake at 180°C / 350°F for about 40 minutes. Fan oven: drop 10°C, check at 35. Cool a full hour before slicing. Short on time? Use 2 cans of chickpeas, drained and rinsed. items.title: Oat & Coffee Ice Cream! No Cream, No Sugar, No Machine
items.description: Creamy coffee ice cream made with oats, yogurt and dates — no cream, no sugar, no ice cream maker. Scoopable, high in protein, just 6 simple ingredients. This homemade coffee oat ice cream has the same smooth, rich texture you'd expect from an ice cream shop, but it's naturally sweetened with dates instead of sugar and thickened with rolled oats and cashews instead of heavy cream. Thick Greek yogurt keeps it creamy and adds plenty of protein, instant coffee gives it a deep latte flavour, and chopped dark chocolate melts into every single bite. You don't need any special equipment for this recipe. The only real trick is stirring the mixture once an hour for the first 2–3 hours in the freezer. That breaks up the ice crystals and gives you a soft, scoopable texture without an ice cream maker. Want it dairy-free? Just swap in a thick plant-based yogurt. Whatever yogurt you use, make sure it's thick — thin yogurt is the number one reason homemade ice cream turns out icy. INGREDIENTS - 60 g rolled oats - 400 g thick Greek yogurt (or thick plant-based yogurt) - 100 g dates, pitted - 50 g cashews - 1 tbsp instant coffee + 3 tbsp warm milk (or water) - 1 tsp instant coffee, for folding in - 30 g dark chocolate, chopped - 1/4 tsp vanilla - A pinch of cinnamon CHAPTERS 00:00 Ice cream with no cream and no sugar 00:14 Oats, cinnamon and vanilla 00:32 Adding the yogurt (and why it rests) 01:05 Soaking the dates and cashews 01:54 Making the coffee 03:24 Blending until smooth and creamy 04:07 Dark chocolate + extra coffee 05:13 Freezing: the stir-every-hour trick 06:45 The final texture TIPS & FAQ Do I need an ice cream maker? No. Stirring the mixture every hour for the first 2–3 hours does the same job. Can I make it vegan? Yes — use a thick plant-based yogurt and water instead of milk for the coffee. Why did mine turn out icy? Usually thin yogurt, or dates that weren't drained properly after soaking. It's too hard to scoop straight from the freezer. Leave it at room temperature for 10–15 minutes and it softens right up. Can I use different dates? Any variety works. Just soak firm dates a little longer. items.description: Got 1 cup of rolled oats? Turn it into these soft, golden oat flatbreads with just warm water and a little salt! No flour, no yeast, no kneading, no added sugar, and no oven needed. If you are looking for a healthy oat bread, this easy flatbread recipe is cooked in a nonstick pan and comes out wonderfully soft and flexible. They’re perfect for wraps, sandwiches, breakfast tacos, or a quick and nutritious snack. @breador Serve them savory with creamy feta cheese, crunchy walnuts, and fresh herbs, or enjoy them with honey and fruit for a sweet breakfast. 👇 SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE EASY & HEALTHY RECIPES: [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCf0Y7Bvjhbz4OOUNG5QV76Q?sub_confirmation=1] 📺 WATCH MORE HEALTHY BREAD RECIPES: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_gUfK4Y_qA&list=PLGZfAkXlxT0LcacKHL9aV1d4FWFkb1YKp] INGREDIENTS 1 cup rolled oats 1 cup warm water, not hot 1/2 teaspoon salt Black and white sesame seeds (optional) INSTRUCTIONS Add the rolled oats, warm water, and salt to a tall blending cup. Blend with an immersion blender until completely smooth. Let the batter rest for 15 minutes. Heat a good nonstick pan. No oil is needed. Pour the batter into small rounds and sprinkle sesame seeds on top. Flip when the surface is set and the edges look dry. Gently press with a spatula to help the flatbreads puff up. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes, then cool on a wire rack. These homemade oat flatbreads are fresh, affordable, and incredibly easy to make. items.title: Make Guilt-Free Fruit Gummies at Home (Zero Sugar!)
items.description: Craving a sweet treat but want to keep it healthy? 🤤 Try these homemade, sugar-free fruit gummies! They are super easy to make, packed with Vitamin C, and perfect for both kids and adults. Made with 100% real fruit juice, honey, and a kick of ginger for an immunity boost! 🌟 @breador 👇 Ingredients: 🍊 2 Oranges 🍊 2 Tangerines 🍋 1 Lemon 🥄 4 tbsp Gelatin powder 🥄 1 tsp Ginger powder 🍯 1 tsp Honey 💧 1/3 cup Water 💡 Pro-Tips for Perfect Gummies: ✅ Perfect Gelatin: Always mix the gelatin powder with cold water first. Then, use the double boiler (bain-marie) method by placing it over a steaming kettle. Stir until all particles dissolve and the liquid is completely clear and lump-free. ✅ Fresh is Best: Make sure to use fresh-squeezed natural fruit juice, not store-bought juice! ✅ Adjust to Taste: The ginger and honey are for extra flavor and health benefits. Feel free to adjust the amounts to your liking! ✅ Easy Removal: Lightly grease your molds with a tiny bit of oil so the gummies pop out easily. ✅ Chill Time: Let them set in the fridge for at least 2 hours until fully firm. Enjoy your healthy, guilt-free snack! 😋 ❤️ If you loved this recipe, don't forget to LIKE, SHARE, and SUBSCRIBE for more easy and healthy treats! #HealthySnacks #SugarFree #HomemadeGummies #HealthyRecipes #FruitJelly #NoSugarAdded #ImmunityBoost #EasyRecipes #Shorts #HealthyDessert

items.title: I haven't bought bread in a year! Just mix chickpeas and lentils for this perfect loaf!
items.description: No flour, no eggs, no oil, no dairy, and no yeast! This healthy homemade gluten-free bread is made with just 3 main ingredients and turns into a beautiful, high-protein loaf that you can slice, toast, and enjoy for daily breakfasts or sandwiches. @breador In this video, I’ll show you how to make an easy, flourless vegan bread without any preservatives, hidden sugar, or artificial additives. Made simply with chickpeas, red lentils, and flaxseed, it's the perfect clean eating recipe if you want a healthy gut and long-lasting energy. 💡 Most Important Tips for this Recipe: Drain the soaking water completely and use fresh cold water for blending. Blend everything until perfectly smooth. Let the dough rest so the flaxseed can bind the ingredients. Let the bread cool completely (1-2 hours) before slicing. Gluten-free bread needs time to set; slicing it hot will make it sticky! 🛒 Ingredients: 150 g chickpeas 150 g red lentils 80 g flaxseed 100 ml cold water 1 tsp baking powder A pinch of salt Optional spices: garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, thyme, or rosemary Optional topping: sesame seeds or any seeds you like 🔥 Bake: 170°C / 340°F for 1 hour in a preheated oven. ⏱️ Chapters: 00:00 - Healthy Gluten-Free Bread Recipe 00:09 - Preparing the chickpeas & lentils 00:35 - Blending the ingredients 01:37 - Adding flaxseed & spices 02:51 - Shaping the dough 03:34 - Baking & the most important cooling tip 03:58 - The final result & texture ------------------------------------- 🌱 Welcome to Breador - Your Home for Health and Flavor! 🌱 🍽️ Discover a world of delectable and nourishing delights right here.
